prompt: This watercolor illustration depicts a cluttered yet charming bicycle repair shop filled with tools and parts. In the center, a mechanic with rolled-up sleeves adjusts the chain of a vintage blue bicycle mounted on a repair stand. To the left, a customer in a raincoat holds a helmet, looking at the bike with anticipation. On the right, a rack displays colorful helmets in red, yellow, and black. A small terrier dog sits on a pile of old tires in the foreground, chewing on a rubber tube. Behind the mechanic, shelves are lined with cans of lubricant, boxes of screws, and spare wheels. A hanging light fixture casts a warm glow over the workspace, highlighting the metallic sheen of wrenches and pliers scattered on the workbench. Another bicycle leans against the back wall, its frame painted bright orange. The watercolor technique allows for soft transitions between the mechanical details and the human figures, creating a lively yet relaxed mood. The interaction between the mechanic and the customer suggests a friendly service exchange, while the dog adds a playful element to the industrial setting. The composition balances the vertical lines of the bikes with the horizontal shelves, creating a dynamic yet cohesive scene.
